community_text:
[Rating: 3/10] It feels odd to play... the climbing aspect into the different open "combos" is interesting, but the game seemed to end with everyone just holding onto their time cards and whoever had the fewest would go"out first" and lose.

[Rating: 3/10] Just not a very good game. Very straightforward card play, and you're at a huge advantage if you can get more of the Stop Time cards. Feels very luck-based without much player agency.

[Rating: 5/10] It seemed to be a work in progress, just playing the least risky cards in order. I don't want to think too much about this game.

[Rating: 6/10] An interesting take on this sort of game, but a bit chaotic for me, at least with five players.

[Rating: 6.5/10] --Jul2022-- Cool people, but a pretty harmless game.  --Nov2023-- And: perhaps better in the fog of imperfect memory than the moment; picked up a copy.

[Rating: 6.5/10] This was actually a nice relaxing card game. Will probably be better with more players. Only tried at 2 P for now.

[Rating: 7/10] A hilarious hand management and push your luck game which is probably let down by its weak art.
